questions.question: Single biggest gap before trusting real vault?
questions.insight: Actions fail, crashes happen, errors unclear. Need rock-solid stability. CODE RED is the right focus.

questions.question: What should AI be doing that it's not?
questions.insight: AI should understand vault structure, patterns, projects. Personalized intelligence, not generic LLM.

questions.question: Core insight that transfers to research?
questions.answer: COMPOSITIONAL: Semantic indexing + Idle-time processing + Trust models + Local-first AI
questions.insight: Not one insight but the system composition. Novel architecture pattern.

questions.question: What would make you proud in 12 months?
questions.answer: LAYERED: First Personal Transformation (POC), then Community + Research + Grant
questions.insight: Personal validation first. Community and research follow proven product.

synthesis: Clear priority stack: Reliability → Context Awareness → Personal Transformation → Community/Research. Research contribution is the compositional architecture, not a single technique. Personal validation (using on real vault) gates all else.
keyDecisions: Context awareness is next priority after stability
